ANJXLXE.bio: ANJXLXE (Anne-Julie) is a Montreal-based singer-songwriter whose music bridges contemporary R&B, soul and pop in French and English. Her debut album ANJXLXE arrived in 2025, earning an ADISQ nomination for R&B/Soul Album of the Year, while singles including Old School Love and Destin helped establish her within Quebec's modern R&B scene. Northern Dial carries ANJXLXE as part of its contemporary Montreal R&B catalogue.

CAIRO!.bio: CAIRO! is a Hamilton, Ontario artist and producer whose catalogue blends hip-hop, phonk and electronic production. Born Cairo Khaleel Weir, he began making beats in 2016 and has since built an independent catalogue that includes collaborations across the contemporary phonk and underground rap scenes. Northern Dial carries CAIRO! as part of its contemporary Ontario hip-hop catalogue.

Culture.bio: Culture is a Canadian-Bahamian rapper and reggae artist best known for appearing on Karl Wolf's hit cover of Africa. His work sits at the intersection of Canadian hip-hop, reggae and pop, with Africa reaching the upper tier of the Canadian Hot 100 and bringing his voice to a national audience. Northern Dial carries Culture as part of its Canadian hip-hop and reggae catalogue.

PRRR.bio: PRRR is a five-piece funk, jazz and soul band formed in Guelph, Ontario in 2023. Built around Grace Fast's vocals with Lucas Williams, Emmitt Leacock, Max De Groot and Jack Williams, the group released its debut EP Patchwork in 2025 and has toured across Ontario, including an appearance at Hillside Festival. Northern Dial carries PRRR as part of its contemporary Ontario independent music catalogue.

Meesah.bio: Meesah is a Pickering, Ontario R&B singer and songwriter whose independent catalogue reaches back to the mid-2000s. Her work centres on smooth contemporary R&B, with releases and collaborations spanning Canada's independent soul and pop ecosystem. Northern Dial carries Meesah as part of its Durham Region and Greater Toronto Area R&B catalogue.
